features.title: Signal store with relevance-ranked handoff briefing
acceptance: POST /api/signals stores a signal with content, tags, workspace, project, and UTC timestamp
GET /api/signals lists signals with pagination and project filtering
GET /api/signals/{id} retrieves a single signal
POST /api/handoff computes a relevance-ranked briefing from stored signals using TF-IDF + temporal decay
Handoff briefing respects a byte budget and returns ranked, truncated signal excerpts
All data endpoints reject unauthenticated requests and enforce role-based access
Frontend dashboard creates signals and generates handoff briefings with loading/error/empty states
Backend has 12+ meaningful pytest tests covering domain logic, persistence, auth, and API workflows
Frontend has 3+ vitest tests covering user-visible behavior

features.title: Signal detail view with inline editing
acceptance: Signal detail view at /signals/:id displays full content, metadata, tags, and relevance score
Operators and admins can edit signal content, tags, and agent_id inline
Admins can delete signals from detail view
Dashboard links signal content to detail view
Role-based access enforced on edit/delete actions

features.title: Optional LLM advisory summaries (opt-in)
acceptance: LLM provider adapters for OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama
Summaries are labeled advisory and grounded in actual signal records
Provider errors never fabricate successful responses

features.title: Production Keycloak OIDC with SAML brokering
acceptance: OIDC authorization-code login with state, nonce, PKCE, and library-validated tokens
Keycloak realm import with SAML identity provider brokering
Production mode refuses demo auth

features.title: Bulk import and export of signals
acceptance: Import signals from JSON with validation
Export filtered signal sets as JSON
